saw_lines: Plant buyers test with one cheap packet or sapling, and they trust a seller only after the first pot survives.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where new buyers decide if this store is safe.
Your site shows 100,000 customers, yet none of your 29 ads carries that number. Put it in the first line of every ad and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 21 Oct 2026
points: Your site says 100,000 customers, yet none of your 29 live ads carries that number, so new buyers get no proof to act on. Put 100,000 customers in the first line of every ad and open two with a review quote.

5 of your 28 copy ads are creator posts run from your brand page, so the voice buyers trust gets lost behind a logo. Whitelist those 5 posts from the creator accounts and cut three variations of the best one.

Your 28 copy ads open with 23 different stories, and the biggest leads only 2 ads. Buyers rarely see the same hook twice, so none sticks. Build the next batch from the two best, the garden and balcony hooks.

9 of your ads have run 60 days or more, so they are proven winners. The oldest is the ZZ Plant unboxing video. Make three more variations of it with different plants from your range, keeping the unboxing format.

ads_1: Two hooks only, the garden and balcony stories, each opening with a review quote
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube
